title: Craftastrophi Emporium
description: My journey in learning Java: The Mod
body:
This mod is the result of my time learning Java with the help of Kaupenjoe's Neoforge tutorials. I could not have made this mod without him, please be sure to check his videos out if you are ever interested in modding: https://www.youtube.com/@ModdingByKaupenjoe.

In this mod you will find a new ore type which becomes accessible post-diamond, a new npc which spawns in the nether, a new tree variant that spawns in forest and plains biomes and other fun additions!
